apropos.title: Zanka Gwarzey Dumi Sahel Ra.
apropos.description: OPE Agadez ti anniya beeri kaŋ ga Nijer zanka carmey beerandi nda i goyey ceeci. Ir ga tammahaŋ kaŋ teerey beerey ga fatta ir al'aada nda hiino tekinoloji margeyaŋ ra.
apropos.pilier_1_desc: Dondonandi beeri zankey se kaŋ ga sohõ nda suba tekinoloji gaabey hanse.
apropos.pilier_2_desc: Ir ga miiley canse ka ciya goyey cimi. Jinayey, jine-dirawey nda gaakasinay doona teeyaŋ ra, ir ga zanka kokoroyey gina.
apropos.pilier_3_desc: Zanka gwarzey marge nda carmey beerey zankey kaŋ ga hiino goyey cimi.
apropos.inspiration_quote: Hamada man ti koonu nango, laakal nda bine-gaabu nango no.
apropos.timeline_subtitle: Bay fondo beerey kaŋ OPE Agadez dira za šintino hala sohõ.
apropos.editorial_title: Aïr tondi beero ra, Agadez ga Nižer caw beero jine-koyyan tonton.
apropos.editorial_quote: Agadez ya UNESCO windi beeri no kaŋ ga bayray fonda gaabu za doona. OPE ga samayey margu konga woo se.
apropos.editorial_p1: Hood College USA 2024 zaama bande, konga woo ga ba ma samaye doonantey gina.
apropos.editorial_p2: Konga ga sintin Nuwamba 2026 ra labo bange kulu ra. Diciemba ra, boro 1 000 ga margu Agadez ra.
apropos.hood_p1: Handu 2024 ra, Nižer samaye 8 koy Hood College UNESCO konga ra USA.
apropos.hood_p2: I zaa jine-jinay IMUN nda STEAM ra nda OPE se nooyan beeri 2.
apropos.pillars_subtitle: Goy fonda kaŋ ga hinay daŋ samayey se Sahel laabo ra.
apropos.p_education_sub: Caw goy teeyan ra ka gina boryo.
apropos.p_education_desc: Teknik nda laabu cawyan konga ra nda koroziyanko beerey.
apropos.p_tech_sub: Za samayey go ga Nižer suba te.
apropos.p_tech_desc: STEAM fondo ra: AI, robote, biyo nda hisaab Agadez ra.
apropos.p_impact_sub: Konga kaŋ ga goy boryo haye tonton.
apropos.p_impact_desc: Turi duma, fuwey teeyan nda laafiya fondo goyey.
apropos.p_tourism_desc: UNESCO windi beero ra koy-di-te, al'ada jinayey nda samayey fari.
apropos.p_network_desc: Samaye doonantey nda goyey jine-borey marguyan.

acteurs.hero_subtitle: Goykaase koroŋey nda alkaaley — wa mayarey caw kaŋ yaŋ go ga CNCEIZ te cimi hay.
acteurs.presi_quote: Nižer ya zankey nda samayey laabu no ndunnya ra. Woodin ya iri arziki beeri no kaŋ ga hima iri ma daŋ goy ra.
acteurs.presi_p1: Goy waani-waani go no kaŋ ga fun bine ra tabbatay do. CNCEIZ konga woodin ya boroy hinay cawyan fondo no.
acteurs.presi_p2: Niamey, Zinder, Maradi, Tahoua nda Agadez ra, zankey go ga jinayey te nda hankal beeri. I ga ba laabu ma di yeeyan fondo no i se.
acteurs.presi_p3: Konga woo ya dooji beeri no kaŋ ga mayi kaŋ laabu n'i di.
acteurs.presi_p4: Konga teeyan Agadez ra ga cabe kaŋ Nižer cerbu beeri go no za doona.
acteurs.presi_p5: Iri g'a ce yaŋ war ma kaa ka gina iri bande konga sintina woo ra.
acteurs.sg_quote: I ga ba yaŋ k'i haŋyaŋ, k'i doonandi nda k'i no fondo i m'i hinay cabe. CNCEIZ konga ya iri turow no.
acteurs.sg_p1: Za OPE sintin, ay di samayey kaŋ ga goy nda ga te jinayey nda ngey hinay boŋ.
acteurs.sg_p2: I si ba dambara, k'i haŋyaŋ nda k'i no fondo hinne no i ga ba.
acteurs.sg_p3: Konga ga margu zankey za jiiri 12 hala 35 STEAM, Koyne goyey nda Jama cawyan fondo ra.
acteurs.sg_p4: Nižer jine-koyyan ga ba iri ma daŋ samayey ga.
acteurs.sg_p5: Ay alhabara ti ay ma cindi i gaa hala i barmayey ma gina.
acteurs.sg_p6: War samayey: wa hantum war boŋ konga woo se.
acteurs.sg_p7: Goykaasayey: wa kaa ka gina iri bande.
acteurs.sg_p8: Nižer si faaba mooru; fondo feeran hinne no.
